findings.current: Destroy the Demonic Path and restore Heaven!
findings.defect: The Korean battle cry names demons as the thing to destroy. “The Demonic Path” instead suggests a path or organization; the following explanatory line correctly says “Destroy demons.”
findings.rationale: The source immediately explains the cry as 마를 멸하고, “destroy demons.” Translating 마 as “the Demonic Path” changes the object of the vow.

findings.current: and forced out a few last words.
findings.defect: This omits that the Blood Lord summoned all his strength to speak.
findings.rationale: 온 힘을 다해 explicitly says he used all his strength; the current wording conveys difficulty but not that degree of effort.
findings.replacement: and forced out a few last words with all his strength.

summary: The scene is largely faithful, but the battle cry shifts the target from demons to a path, and one line omits the emphasis on the monster’s effort.
